title: Timber Flooring – Parquet & Planks
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Base dry to max 65% RH and room humidity 45–65%?
Undercarriage levelled to SR1 for the 22 mm build-up?
Pattern and grade match the sample?
Expansion gaps kept: 8 mm to other floors, 15 mm at edges?

guide.title: Timber floor – SJWS limits
rows: 8 mm to other floors, 15 mm at edges
knot/sap free as the approved sample; no dark boards side by side
guide.src: Block 5 benchmark BM-ZZ32 (BS 8201); Pica ITP ESC-00035

questions.q: Ask the fitter: What header joint and lipping tolerance are you working to? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Materials delivered undamaged and stored acclimatising in the room?

notOk.t: Floor boxes higher/lower than the floor or not opening
Stains and marks on the floor
Header joints over 0.6 mm; lipping over 0.5 mm (BS 8201 – BM-ZZ32)
Mastic missing at window frames and terrace doors
Colour out of tolerance / poor repairs
